page.content:
Florida launch center on Merritt Island beside Cape Canaveral.

How Kennedy Space Center connects

  • Event: Apollo 11 — Apollo 11 launched from Kennedy Space Center's Launch Complex 39.
  • Topic: NASA — Kennedy Space Center is NASA's primary launch site.
  • Location: Cape Canaveral — Kennedy Space Center sits on Merritt Island beside Cape Canaveral.

What is Kennedy Space Center?

Kennedy Space Center is NASA's primary launch site: Apollo and Shuttle from LC-39, now Artemis and commercial crews, with the Vehicle Assembly Building as its landmark.

Key threads lead to Apollo 11, NASA and Cape Canaveral.
